page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical cores with 2 vCPUs, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs.

This instance relies entirely on network-attached storage, as local storage is not bundled. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 makes it a resource-dense option for workloads requiring significant memory capacity relative to processing power, avoiding the need to provision excess vCPUs simply to obtain more RAM.

Given the 16.0 GB memory capacity paired with 2 dedicated vCPUs, the ecs.s2.2xlarge is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel processing. Appropriate workloads include small-scale databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and lightweight web servers that benefit from a larger memory footprint.
